android.desc:
AT4K Launcher is a fast, clean Android TV launcher designed to replace cluttered home screens with a smooth, modern TV experience.

If you’re looking for a lightweight TV launcher that feels responsive, easy to navigate, and visually calm, AT4K delivers a simple home screen built specifically for Android TV and Google TV devices.

Unlike heavy or ad-filled launchers, AT4K focuses on speed, clarity, and usability. Every interaction is optimized for remote control navigation, large screens, and smooth performance.

KEY FEATURES

• Clean and minimal Android TV launcher interface
• Extremely fast and lightweight performance
• Custom App Icons
• Organise apps in folders 
• WIDGETS: Weather, clock, channels, 2048 and many more widgets
• Smooth animations and instant focus navigation
• Smart Watch Next row with content previews
• Focusing an app shows its available programs automatically
• Favorites row for quick access
• All apps grid with fast scrolling
• Easy app reordering using long press
• Hide or show featured cards
• Light and dark themes
• Custom wallpapers and gradients
• Works offline for daily use
• No ads, no tracking, no clutter

OPTIMIZED FOR TV

AT4K Launcher is built specifically for:
• Android TV
• Google TV
• Smart TVs and TV boxes
• Remote and D-pad navigation

Everything is designed to feel natural on a television screen.

WHY CHOOSE AT4K LAUNCHER

• Faster than many traditional TV launchers
• Cleaner home screen without distractions
• Simple layout that stays consistent
• Reliable performance even on older TV hardware
• Focused on usability instead of gimmicks

Whether you want a minimalist launcher, a customizable TV launcher, or simply a faster Android TV home screen, AT4K gives you a smooth and modern experience.

(i) Some Watch Next features depend on device support and installed apps.
(ii) Some features like custom app icons require a one time premium upgrade

Accessibility Service Notice: AT4K Launcher includes an optional accessibility service, solely used to improve navigation by allowing custom actions via remote control shortcuts. No data is collected or shared.

Enjoy a cleaner, faster Android TV home screen with AT4K Launcher,, download now.

show_hn.title: Show HN: AT4K Launcher - Apple TV inspired Launcher for Android TVs

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I'm the developer of OffChess a Hackernews favorite Chess puzzles app. About 6 months ago I saw someone reviewing an Apple TV 4k on their youtube channel and it looked vastly superior in terms of UI and UX to what Android based Google TVs provide. I asked the people over at r/AndroidTV if someone has ported Apple TV experience to Android TV and they said no. So I built a makeshift video and posted on Reddit. People there loved it and started sending me Reddit chat messages every day to build and launch it.

So it took me 3 months to solve all edge cases and I built and launched AT4K Launcher in January and people absolutely loved it. Since then BGR, Android Authority, Makeuseof and multiple tech websites have featured it as one of the best Android Launchers.

Clean, fast, minimal, pretty, no accounts, no tracking, no monthly subscriptions, no internet required. Just you and your apps. With Live wallpaper, custom app icons, icon packs support and multiple ways to modify your home screen AT4K Launcher packs everything you need in a neat ui.

Here is the play store link-
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.overdevs.at4k

Would love feedback, bug reports, or suggestions.

Thanks!
